The challenge before us is to compute solutions of
\[\dot{\boldsymbol q}=\boldsymbol M^{-1}\boldsymbol p,\qquad \dot{\boldsymbol p}=\boldsymbol F(\boldsymbol q)=-\nabla U(\boldsymbol q),\]
or, more compactly, with $\boldsymbol z$ representing the collection of all positions and momenta,
\[\dot{\boldsymbol z}=\boldsymbol f(\boldsymbol z),\qquad \boldsymbol f(\boldsymbol z)=\boldsymbol J\nabla H,\tag{2.1}\]
corrected_json.proof_note: 原书未给独立完整证明。
context_notation: $\boldsymbol z=(\boldsymbol q,\boldsymbol p)$；$H$见同页MD-2-Hamiltonian条目；此处$n$为配置坐标数，对应第1章§1.2的$N_c$。
$\boldsymbol I$为$n\times n$单位阵，$\boldsymbol 0$为同尺寸零块；教材坐标顺序为$(\boldsymbol q,\boldsymbol p)$。
$\boldsymbol M$为固定对角质量矩阵；$\boldsymbol F(\boldsymbol q)=-\nabla U(\boldsymbol q)$为力，$\boldsymbol f$为完整相空间向量场。
extra_assumptions: 原文ODE按时间域I逐点解释；只定义关系，不宣称解存在。

corrected_json.statement_latex: Suppose that the system under study has a well defined flow map $\mathscr F_t$ defined on the phase space (which is assumed to exclude any singular points of the potential energy function). The solution of the initial value problem, $\dot{\boldsymbol z}=\boldsymbol f(\boldsymbol z)$, $\boldsymbol z(0)=\boldsymbol\zeta$, may be written $\boldsymbol z(t,\boldsymbol\zeta)$ (with $\boldsymbol z(0,\boldsymbol\zeta)=\boldsymbol\zeta$), and the flow-map $\mathscr F_t$ satisfies $\mathscr F_t(\boldsymbol\zeta)=\boldsymbol z(t,\boldsymbol\zeta)$. A one-step method, starting from a given point, approximates a point on the solution trajectory at a given time $h$ units later. Such a method defines a map $\mathscr G_h$ of the phase space as illustrated in Fig. 2.1.
corrected_json.proof_note: 原书未给独立完整证明。
context_notation: $\mathscr F_t(\boldsymbol\zeta)=\boldsymbol z(t,\boldsymbol\zeta)$为给定实际ODE的流；初值为$\boldsymbol z(0,\boldsymbol\zeta)=\boldsymbol\zeta$。
$\mathscr G_h$为相空间上的单步近似映射，其目标是$h$时间单位后的实际流$\mathscr F_h$；图2.1标$\boldsymbol z_1=\mathscr G_h(\boldsymbol\zeta)$并与$\boldsymbol z(h,\boldsymbol\zeta)=\mathscr F_h(\boldsymbol\zeta)$比较。
该相空间被假定排除势能函数的所有奇异点；本段未规定定量误差、收敛性或误差阶，近似质量由后面的误差定义衡量。
原页使用RSFS花体流映射符号，故记作$\mathscr F_t,\mathscr G_h$；原页解记号中时间与初值以逗号分隔。
extra_assumptions: [EXTRA] EAUDIT01在开放正规相空间D排除势能不可微/奇异点；F的已给全时解族与初值/完整机械ODE相联，G作用于同一D，Z关联全部实际n次迭代。oneStepTargetDifference明确目标F_h与G_h的差；原段未规定定量近似质量，未加入虚构误差阶或收敛结论。全时流是此接口的给定模型资格，不是解存在定理。
